selection_rationale: Same-scale fate continuation from 5% crossing mother states, common horizon 40000 sweeps. Mothers chosen outcome-blind (all compact_16 crossing states; smallest-seed 15 of random_16) from the fresh-seed replication campaign. Directional predictions registered from measured J diagnostics before any continuation: (1) random-source mothers on the original field keep high q_B (marginal-band grinding continues); (2) the adapted arm replaces the field with the fixed-strategy equilibrium, whose measured J_eq is negative at growing random16 states (median about -2.6), so q_B should fall; (3) the shifted arm (fixed translation (17,12), preserving totals, histogram and autocorrelation) breaks strategy-resource alignment and should also lower q_B, weakly; (4) compact-source mothers get their first fate measurement with no directional prediction. Screening-level committor estimates with per-mother Wilson noise; unresolved stays unresolved.
interpretation: finite-horizon fate probabilities per mother and resource arm; no infinite-time committor, no causal decomposition of the original geometry risk difference
